implementation.behavior: Substitute the second polynomial for the first declared generator of the first polynomial, preserving the remaining typed generators as coefficient variables and the original prime field.
implementation.acceptance: Separate ascending-power coefficient convolution checks the full original polynomial identity; point evaluation does not establish acceptance.
implementation.public_api: Poly/PurePoly.compose and module-level compose; explicit polys=False returns an expression.
implementation.bounds: Existing bounded prime-field multivariate source/ring/term/work/allocation limits remain; composition growth includes the retained coefficient axes and is preflighted before expansion.
implementation.tests_authored: Seven new native regression functions plus Compose in the existing arithmetic-mutant campaign; 14 new public test functions with parameterization.
implementation.remaining: No new protected verifier reservation or active CallbackSession forwarding for the existing finite-field bridge; no extension-field or general multivariate factorization claim.

implementation.behavior: Dense mutable and immutable Matrix.pinv for exact Q(i), including rectangular and rank-deficient matrices.
implementation.generation: Rational realification and the existing sparse rational candidate generator.
implementation.acceptance: A distinct dense Q(i) reference checker re-reads original A and X and verifies AXA=A, XAX=X, (AX)*=AX and (XA)*=XA, including real Hermitian diagonals.
implementation.source_and_runtime: Retained original scalar/storage binding, original native descriptors, cumulative active request accounting, terminal cancellation and final publication checks.
implementation.bounds: Complex or active-session lane: each axis <=32; input/output components <=4096 bits; intermediate envelope <=8192 bits; native call <=20M compute units and <=256 MiB cumulative logical allocation. Ordinary literal-rational default behavior retained.
implementation.tests_authored: 18 native integration functions, two private reference tests and 14 public test functions (39 parameterized cases).
implementation.remaining: Same-crate synchronous reference checking, not a new portable proof-kernel certificate or protected verifier-pool claim.

implementation.defect: The previous default used A^T A and could accept -1/3 for A=[1,2i]^T, b=[1,0]^T. The Hermitian solution is 1/5.
implementation.behavior: Bounded exact Q(i) full-column-rank solve_least_squares default/CH, including multiple RHS and dense or sparse RHS classes; result retains the coefficient matrix class.
implementation.acceptance: Existing independent sparse rank and normal-equation verification on realifications, followed by a separate direct original Q(i) check of A*(AX-B)=0.
implementation.source_and_runtime: Both original operands are admitted before generation. Joint lane selection bounds mixed complex/literal inputs before snapshotting or densifying. Sparse RHS conversion uses original native descriptors, with pre/post original-source checks. Active sessions retain cumulative accounting through publication.
implementation.bounds: Same bounded Q(i) dimensions/height/work/allocation envelope as the Gaussian pseudoinverse path.
implementation.tests_authored: 13 native integration functions, one private residual-mutation test and 18 public test functions (65 parameterized cases).
implementation.remaining: Rank-deficient CH requests refuse. Complete PINV least-squares families remain on the existing rational-only path. Existing native singular-error ValueError policy is retained; upstream CH uses TypeError.
